name: content-masking-tool
description: Masks known company/people names in local documents before they reach the AI; restores them on request. Dev build — runs from the project venv on this machine.

tools.name: mask_document
tools.description: Mask company/people names in a local document (.md/.txt/.docx/.pdf); returns masked text + vault_id

tools.name: restore_text
tools.description: Restore original names into masked text using a vault_id

tools.name: restore_document
tools.description: Restore original names into a masked file and write it next to the original
